title: Attempt to weaken a protected promise
scenario: A proposed edit changes a protected MFA requirement into an optional recommendation. The proposed weaker wording must be refused and must never be promoted as the repaired promise.

claims.text: Every administrator account must use multifactor authentication.
Administrators may optionally use multifactor authentication.

expected.rationale: The proposal weakens a protected requirement; refuse it and do not promote the weaker wording.
